description.en: Subtracted the initial investment from the undiscounted future cash flow, forgetting to divide by (1+r)^n first.
description.et: Lahutas alginvesteeringu diskonteerimata tulevasest rahavoost, unustades selle enne jagada (1+r)^n-ga.

description.en: Discounted the future cash flow correctly but forgot to subtract the initial investment.
description.et: Diskonteeris tulevase rahavoo õigesti, kuid unustas alginvesteeringu lahutamata.

description.en: Multiplied the future cash flow by (1+r)^n instead of dividing by it, growing the value instead of discounting it.
description.et: Korrutas tulevase rahavoo (1+r)^n-ga selle asemel, et sellega jagada, kasvatades väärtust diskonteerimise asemel.
